title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer during regional failover + load-shedding
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: During a regional outage triggered in prod-aws-us-west we observed the SLO enforcer aggressively shedding traffic in the 'cold' region after a regional failover. The root cause was an ordering/regression introduced when we added prioritized backoff for queued requests: the enforcer could double-apply backoff + load-shedding when a regional failover and a concurrent scaling event happened, which caused a transient overshoot of shed traffic and elevated error budgets in dependent services.

This hotfix stabilizes the SLO enforcer by: 1) making backoff/hysteresis idempotent for a request path (preventing double-application), 2) tightening ordering guarantees between regional-failover coordinator and local shedder to avoid race windows, and 3) introducing a short grace window after failover where shedding thresholds are smoothed.

What changed (high level):
- Fix: ensure backoff tokens are consumed exactly once per request lifecycle and add an explicit request-level guard to prevent double-shedding.
- Fix: explicit ordering fence between regional-failover actions and local queue trimming (rely on coordinator epoch).
- Tweak: smooth shedding thresholds for 30s after detected regional failover to avoid thrashing.
- Tests: unit tests for backoff idempotency + integration test simulating failover + burst load.
- Observability: add metrics (slo_enforcer.double_shed_detected, slo_enforcer.shed_grace_window_active) and a debug log when ordering fences are used.

Checklist: 
- [x] Reproduced locally with integration harness (failover + burst).
- [x] Added unit & integration tests.
- [x] CI green after rerun.
- [x] Release notes drafted.

Notes: This is a targeted hotfix only for the enforcer and coordinator interaction; it does not change global shedding policy defaults. We will follow up with an RFC to surface the new metrics in the Console and to consider increasing the default grace window if we see similar incidents across regions.

Related: ENG-4521 (incident and postmortem), ENG-4580 (follow-up observability work), SUP-1123 (customer report).

short_summary: Fixes double-application of backoff + load-shedding during regional failover by making backoff idempotent, adding ordering fences, and smoothing thresholds for a 30s grace window. Includes tests and new metrics.
